owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setPerpAsset(uint32).details: Only while the position is flat — avoids reinterpreting an open hedge.

setSpotConfig(uint64).details: Only while flat — avoids reinterpreting an open hedge.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

bridgeBackToEvm(uint64).notice: Step 4 (unwind) — return USDC Core→EVM via sendAsset to the system address. NOTE: the contract must hold some HYPE on Core to pay transfer gas, otherwise the action is dropped (silently).

bridgeUsdcToCore(uint256).notice: Step 1 — bridge USDC EVM→Core (lands in the contract's SPOT balance). This is what initializes the contract's HyperCore account; any action must be sent in a LATER block (see design doc).

delegateHype(address,uint64,bool).notice: Delegate / undelegate staked HYPE to a validator (action 3).

hedgeTransferOut(address,uint64).notice: Spot-send the hedge straight from the contract's Core spot balance (action 6) — the unwind path for hedge sizes below HL's $10 order minimum (orders can't express them; a send can).

marginSummary().notice: NOTE: takes (perpDexIndex, user) — verified against mainnet.

moveUsdcToPerp(uint64).notice: Move USDC spot→perp (or back) on Core. `ntl` is USDC perp units (6 decimals; 1 USDC = 1e6).

openShort(uint32,uint64,uint64,uint8).notice: Open the short hedge (sell perp). limitPx/sz are 10^8 × human value; sz must respect the asset's szDecimals (keeper reads 0x80a).

openSpotBuy(uint64,uint64,uint8).notice: Buy the spot hedge — the LONG leg that cancels the short's price exposure (HIGH-2 fix). `limitPx`/`sz` are 10^8 × human value; sz must respect the pair's szDecimals (keeper derives from pxScale). HL spot orders enforce a $10 minimum on the REQUESTED notional.

perpAsset().notice: HyperCore perp asset index (0 = BTC, 1 = ETH on validator perps).

sellSpot(uint64,uint64,uint8).notice: Sell the spot hedge (unwind path). Spot orders take no reduceOnly flag. Requests under $10 are rejected by HL — use hedgeTransferOut for sub-$10 hedge sizes.

setSpotConfig(uint64).notice: Configure the spot hedge pair (HIGH-2). Derives everything from the live 0x80b/0x80c reads: base token index + szDecimals → px scale.

spotHedgeSz().notice: Spot hedge size (1e8 units — Core spot wei for HYPE). Safe: 0 when the spot leg is unconfigured or the read fails.

spotPairIndex().notice: Spot hedge config (HIGH-2 fix). `spotPairIndex` = HyperCore spot pair index (e.g. 107 = HYPE/USDC); `spotTokenIndex` = derived base-token index; `spotAsset` = spot ORDER asset (10000 + pairIndex); `spotPxScale` = 10^(10 - szDecimals) so spotValue6 = spotSz(1e8) * spotPxRaw / scale yields USDC 6dp. 0 = spot leg disabled — never claim delta-neutral then.

spotPx().notice: Live spot price for the hedge pair (raw; human px = raw / 10^(8 - szDecimals)). Safe: 0 on failure.

spotValue6().notice: Spot hedge value in USDC 6dp. Safe: 0 on any read failure — totalAssets math must never revert on a precompile hiccup.

stakeHype(uint64).notice: Stake HYPE held on the contract's Core spot balance (action 4). Owner-gated: policy op, not routine keeper work.

usdc().notice: USDC on HyperEVM (constructor arg for testability; deploy scripts pass HLConstants.usdc() — chainid-aware mainnet/testnet).

withdrawStake(uint64).notice: Withdraw HYPE from staking back to Core spot (action 5).
